consensusMembership.detail: On the rs-raft path the core's committed ConfState is current consensus membership. Stable peer identity reservation and service/cache metadata are separate host concerns; metadata may request/project a transition but is not itself the committed configuration.

transport.outbound: raft-rs runtime owner -> sendToPeer -> PartitionService request callback -> MessageRouter.deliver
transport.inbound: MessageRouter handler -> PartitionService.handleTransportMessage -> isRaftPacket -> operation-port step only for recognized current packet vocabulary
